name: forgeplan-orchestra
description: Unified workflow: Forgeplan artifacts + Orchestra task tracking + Claude Code AI execution. Bidirectional sync, Session Start Protocol with Inbox Pattern, and methodology knowledge base. Requires forgeplan CLI (private app, access via project admin) + Orchestra MCP server. v1.5.0: /sync field-write path fixed — the non-existent set_fields replaced by update_entity, fields passed as {fieldUid, value} with UIDs resolved via list_fields, create_entity moved to the entities[] form (marketplace#208). v1.6.0: read-before-act on task chats, Blocked as a Status (never a phase), checklists from acceptance criteria + a Done-with-open-items report, Artifact backfill from task names with per-row confirmation, pinned workspace UIDs, orphans reported never deleted (marketplace#210). v1.10.0: docs re-verified live against BOTH Orchestra server variants — failure-modes gains the endpoint-split table (agent endpoint: add_relation/approve_action exist, but no create/document layer, hanging message reads, folder:all can drop a project); required checklistUid restored in item examples; create_entity subtask shorthand fixed to entities[]; field-map.sh learns ORCH_MCP_TOKEN; server resolution pinned per project via .claude/orchestra.json (marketplace#282). v1.11.0: server resolution made deterministic and runtime-neutral — NEW scripts/orch-verify.sh resolves the project orchestra.json pin (.agents/ canonical, .claude/ fallback; schema v2: url + tokenEnv + per-runtime names map), handshakes and compares live space/user against the pin; exit 0 = safe to write, 65 = mismatch stop, 66/69/78 = no-config/unreachable/bad-config (marketplace#282). v1.12.0: re-verified live against Orchestra 0.141-beta-0906 — the build that closed folder:all under-reporting, null field-filters, hanging message reads, agent-endpoint creation, move_entity, the document layer, checklist ordering and flat project queries; failure-modes rewritten to keep only what still reproduces (threads unreadable, config write-only, two field shapes) and to add two new ones (delete_entity hangs globally with no error; the daemon can refuse every tool while loading and not recover); orch-verify.sh gains exit 75 NOT_READY; the agent endpoint is documented as a bot identity, not the human (marketplace#282). v2.0.0 (BREAKING — file paths moved): the platform knowledge is split out of the runbook into a second, ecosystem-free skill `orchestra-mcp` — failure-modes, the server verifier, the field-map script, plus new fields/entities/rendering/query-cookbook references, with zero forgeplan and zero of this project's field vocabulary, so it stands alone and can be published for `npx skills add`. `orchestra-task-cycle` keeps the seven gated stages, our field model and the evidence path, and now cites the universal skill as the authority on tool behaviour. Both descriptions carry an explicit mutual-exclusion clause so they never compete for a trigger. Anything referencing skills/orchestra-task-cycle/{scripts,references/failure-modes.md} must be repointed to skills/orchestra-mcp/ (marketplace#282). v3.0.0 (BREAKING — the runbook skill is renamed and its config moved): the seven-stage runbook is now `task-cycle`, not `orchestra-task-cycle` — and it is TRACKER-AGNOSTIC by construction. Its stages name canonical operations (list startable / read one / claim / tick / report / close) and canonical field ROLES (status / stage marker / who / which model / blocked-by), never the tool names of one product; what each one concretely is comes from the project via a new `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`, so the same runbook drives Orchestra here and Jira, Linear or GitHub Issues elsewhere. Resolution order: read that file, else ask the human ONCE, else detect by BARE tool-name signature, else stop and ask on a tie — never guess, because writing into the wrong system is not undone by apologising. `references/field-model.md` is renamed `references/project-fields.md` and reframed as this project's instance of the role table; the examples stay explicitly Orchestra-flavoured. NEW agent `task-runner` (Profile B-orchestrator scoped to the tracker): it drives the seven gates, verifies which server and whose identity it holds before the first write, dispatches `smith` for the methodology and a Profile A/B agent for artifacts, and writes no source files and no forgeplan mutations — deliberately NOT a 15th smith routing row, because the board envelope composes with a methodology row instead of competing with one. The connection pin moves to `docs/agents/orchestra.json` beside issue-tracker.md; `.agents/orchestra.json` and `.claude/orchestra.json` still resolve and print a deprecation notice on stderr (verified live: legacy path exits 0 with the notice, canonical beats legacy, and stdout stays valid JSON under --json). Anything referencing skills/orchestra-task-cycle/ must be repointed to skills/task-cycle/ (marketplace#282).
